text.p: American Science and Engineering Inc said it won a preliminary injunction against Annistech Inc regarding American Science trade secrets and proprietary technology.
American Science said the injunction was issued by a Massachusetts trial court and upheld by a single justice of the Massachusetts Appeals Court.
American Science said it has battling with Annistech and Martin Annis, an Annistech official, regarding Annis's termination by American Science and his activities since.

American Science has alleged that Annistech and Annis misappropriated trade secrets. American Science develops and manufactures sophisticated X-ray inspection products, including the Z(R) Backscatter technology that detects plastic explosives, illegal drugs, and other contraband.
